audience: home care providers who plan carer rotas, leave and payroll codes in CareLineLive

useCases.title: Find carers on leave in a period
useCases.text: Search the carers, excluding those on leave in a period. Then read the leave records for the same dates.

useCases.title: Look up a carer by payroll number
useCases.text: Search the carers with partial-match filters, such as a payroll number. Open one carer to read the contract, team and employment fields.

useCases.title: Review visit rounds and work patterns
useCases.text: List the visit rounds of the carers. Read the work patterns that plan contracts, and the public holidays set up for the environment.

useCases.title: Check office users and token permissions
useCases.text: List the office users and open one to read its details. List the permissions to see what the access token can read.

useCases.title: Update payroll and cost centre codes
useCases.text: Open the carer to read the current codes. Then change the payroll number, payroll department code or cost centre code. Only the fields you send change.
